dict.string: Mesh Monitor listens only when you start Talk or microphone captions, or after an armed physical AIY wake when its conversation connection is ready. Captions stay local; Talk sends your transcribed question to the selected agent.
Mesh Monitor uses on-device speech transcription for conversations you start.
Mesh Monitor captures screen images only when you choose screen evidence. Mac audio captions use local system audio capture without reading video frames or sending transcripts to an agent.
Mesh Monitor uses the camera you enable for local presence and head-pointer calibration. Camera evidence is sent to Codex only when you explicitly select it for a question.
Mesh Monitor reads events only from the Home calendar you select to show your current schedule. It does not read Family or Work or edit events.
macOS requires calendar access to read events. Mesh Monitor reads only your selected Home calendar and does not edit events. Selected task context can be included in a question to Codex.
Mesh Monitor can connect to a camera stream address you provide on your local network. It does not discover or connect to other devices automatically.
